card.name: Words before 'patients' in instructions
card.fires_on: Words in drug-label administration sections that lead into instructions to patients, such as 'Instruct' split as In|struct, 'Advise', or 'for Use'. Also the word 'suspension' or 'infusion' after 'oral' or 'Intravenous'.

modes.label: Instruct/Advise patients
modes.description: The verb that begins an instruction to patients, often partway through 'Instruct'.
modes.example: 2.3 Important Administration Instructions In<<struct>> patients to read the “Instructions for Use

modes.label: Dosage form names
modes.description: The final word of a dosage form or route phrase such as oral suspension or intravenous infusion.

card.plain: It fires on the wording that introduces patient instructions or names a dosage form like oral suspension or infusion.
